fieldValues.title: A PR decision is a choice, a ruling or an escalation
fieldValues.decision_question: Which decisions made in a PR go to a decision log?
fieldValues.context: Proposed by agent:claude-code from the srs-lab control room (clerk#77). Prototyped against the live PRs on 2026-10-17: clerk#57 asked for thirteen decisions already ratified; srs-programme#154 and #155 proposed decisions only inside their diffs, in state draft; clerk#75 stated a constraining design principle in prose.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A choice fails the Reuse test and stays in the PR block; a ruling passes the four tests inside the group mandate and is proposed in the group own log; an escalation is outside the mandate and is proposed in the parent log, with an ask in the PR.
fieldValues.rationale: Logs hold only what governs later choices (the four tests); choices are still structured, so nothing is lost, without filling logs or sessions.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a choice is later found to settle another choice, or a group log fills with rulings no later work cites.
